    Paperpile library

    Sync a BibTeX file from Paperpile, then cite by key as you write.

    Citation syntax

    Use Pandoc-style citations such as [@Smith2024], [@Smith2024; @Lee2023] or [see @Smith2024, p. 4]. The preview formats them and builds a reference list from your BibTeX file.

    Manuscript tools

    Images and figures

    Open or add image files to preview them inline. Keep image paths relative so the manuscript stays portable in GitHub. Images are previewed for this session only and are not committed to GitHub.

    GitHub workflow

    Load a manuscript from a repository, edit it here, then save a commit back to that file.

    Keyboard shortcuts
    • ⌘/Ctrl + B — bold
    • ⌘/Ctrl + I — italic
    • ⌘/Ctrl + S — download the Markdown file
    • ⌘/Ctrl + Shift + C — citation picker
    • Esc — close a dialog
